newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian stocks fall further, Roja slides.
newsitem.headline: Latvian stocks fall further, Roja slides.

text.p: Latvian share volumes dipped further on Wednesday but were still some 10,000 lats better than this year's lowest levels as stocks kept sliding, dealers said.
Total turnover came to 73,000 lats against 116,000 lats and the Rietumu index fell 0.34 percent to 194.83.
Secondary list stock Kaija was in demand as it traded 23,900 lats of shares but remained stable at 2.56 lats.
Official list share Riga Transport Fleet was down five santimes to 1.53 lats after its 1996 profit figures. It had share trade volume of 2,100 lats.
It yesterday said it had a 1996 profit of 182,719 lats versus 172,418 lats.
"The fall in price was a partial reaction to the profit figures, which were seen by some market players as lower than expected," said Harijs Zulgis, dealer at Rigas komercbanka.
"The demand for RTF was rather low today and the full impact of the figures may be seen tomorrow as the news spreads (in the press)," he added.
Roja fish cannery was among the day's big losers, down to 2.41 lats from 2.82 or 14.5 percent but trade was small at 400 lats.
Daugavpils Chain advanced five santimes to 2.70 lats and traded 12,800 lats.
On the official list, Unibanka had volume of 10,800 lats as it slipped five santimes to 1.53.
"Some 80 percent of Unibanka shares are blocked ahead of the bank's shareholders' meeting on April 21," Viestur Shterns, Unibanka head of equities department said.
"Our share price has lowered after April 7, proportionally to the amount of dividends paid out," he added.
Fellow official list share, the Staburadze confectionery, remained stable at 2.66 lats on volume of 5,300 lats.
The company earlier said, that its unaudited 1996 profit came to some 200,000 lats against 270,000 lats in 1995.
Valmiera Glassfibre was up five santimes to 1.67 lats on volume of 6,400 lats.
